adobe_provenance_policy.rule: Every VOCE publication originates in Adobe Express before publication.
adobe_provenance_policy.archive_inclusion: Require an Adobe Express provenance match or mark provenance_pending until deterministically matched; never treat social media as the editorial source.
adobe_provenance_policy.social_role: Metricool/social platforms confirm publication and provide the final published text when Adobe creative contains only title/visual.
